allow: Bash(cmd.exe /c "where node 2>&1 & where npm 2>&1 & where npx 2>&1")

Bash(powershell.exe -Command "Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Source; Get-Command npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Source; [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\('PATH','Machine'\) -split ';' | Select-String -Pattern 'node|npm'")
